definition.en: Foreign banks are banking institutions headquartered in a foreign country that operate branches or subsidiaries within the domestic Indian economy under the regulatory framework of the Reserve Bank of India.
definition.hi: Foreign banks are banking institutions headquartered in a foreign country that operate branches or subsidiaries within the domestic Indian economy under the regulatory framework of the Reserve Bank of India.

importanceInUpsc.en: Understanding foreign banks is essential for UPSC GS-3 as they represent a critical component of the financial sector, influencing capital inflows, competition, and technological adoption. Questions often focus on their regulatory compliance, role in financial inclusion, and impact on the domestic banking landscape.
